vibe_rationale: Intimate, curated, site-specific art festival in a remote West Coast town, with strong community and art credibility though small and hard to reach.
fit_notes: Adventurous adult contemporary art audience with wilderness wellbeing appeal, though age data is unpublished. A newly appointed partnerships and stakeholder manager, a partners page and 26 listed partners make the route open, and most of the program is free, but it is biennial and remote, so this is a one-off 2027 partnership.
